## Tự gắn chuyên mục cho bài WordPress
**Làm gì:** Quét bài WordPress, AI đọc nội dung và gán đúng chuyên mục có sẵn trên site.
**Trigger:** Bấm tay (Execute workflow)
**Credential cần:** OpenAI, WordPress
**Chi phí ước:** Token rất thấp (chỉ phân loại).
**Mở rộng gợi ý:** Chạy theo lịch mỗi đêm cho bài mới; thêm bước gắn tag.

---
**Nguồn:** Kho awesome-n8n-templates (Enes Cingoz tổng hợp, giấy phép CC BY 4.0)
https://github.com/enescingoz/awesome-n8n-templates/blob/main/WordPress/Auto-Categorize%20blog%20posts%20in%20wordpress%20using%20A.I..json
Nhãn TAG: **Recommend** (chọn lọc theo DNA khoá, học viên tự import; TAG đổi nhãn khi test xong).
Import: n8n → Create workflow → ⋯ → Import from file. Sau khi import, mở từng node đỏ để chọn credential của bạn.

## How to Auto-Categorize 82 Blog Posts in 2 Minutes using A.I. (No Coding Required)

💡 Read the [case study here](https://rumjahn.com/how-to-use-a-i-to-categorize-wordpress-posts-and-streamline-your-content-organization-process/).

📺 Watch the [youtube tutorial here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IvQioioVqhw)

### Get wordpress posts

Turn off return all if you're running into issues.

### A.I. Categorization

1. you need to set up the categories first in wordpress

2. Edit the message prompt and change the categories and category numbers

=You are an expert content strategist and taxonomy specialist with extensive experience in blog categorization and content organization.

I will provide you with a blog post's title. Your task is to assign ONE primary category ID from this fixed list:

13 = Content Creation
14 = Digital Marketing
15 = AI Tools
17 = Automation & Integration
18 = Productivity Tools
19 = Analytics & Strategy

Analyze the title and return only the single most relevant category ID number that best represents the main focus of the post. While a post might touch on multiple topics, select the dominant theme that would be most useful for navigation purposes.

{{ $json.title.rendered }}

Output only the category number
